name: Deploy GalviCare QA Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - qa-revamped-galvicare-0-5
    paths:
      - "worker/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "wrangler.json"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-galvicare-qa.yml"
      - "scripts/verify-qa-runtime.mjs"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: galvicare-qa-worker
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test-deploy-verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Verify branch
        run: test "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" = "qa-revamped-galvicare-0-5"

      - name: Run GalviCare automated gate
        run: |
          npm test
          npm run stabilization:gate
          git diff --check

      - name: Deploy existing QA Worker
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: deploy --config wrangler.json

      - name: Verify deployed QA runtime
        env:
          GALVICARE_QA_WORKER_URL: https://galvicare-triage-intake.mrgalvipro.workers.dev/api
        run: node scripts/verify-qa-runtime.mjs
